original.target_description: Study 1 age-group effect on internal (episodic) AI detail scores in repeated-measures ANOVA with temporal direction and time period; source page 4, printed p. 36.

n.sample_role: Analytic participants in mutually exclusive final groups: 16 young adults and 16 older adults; repeated temporal conditions within participants.
n.exclusions: One young and one older adult excluded for technical difficulties from 17 recruited per age group.
n.location: Printed p. 34, Method—Participants; p. 36, Results—Adapted AI model specification.
n.quote: Data from 1 young adult and 1 older adult were excluded ... because of technical difﬁculties; thus, data from 16 young and ... 16 older adults are presented.

p.location: Printed p. 36 (source page 4), Results—Adapted AI, internal-detail age-group effect.

notes: Primary-source identity verified: matching article title, authors Donna Rose Addis, Alana T. Wong, and Daniel L. Schacter, DOI header 10.1111/j.1467-9280.2008.02043.x, Research Article designation, Psychological Science volume 19, pp. 33–41. Full primary article text includes methods, results, discussion, references; no PDF supplied. Target located using episodic (internal) detail outcome and page-4 Adapted AI age-group analysis, not numeric matching. This group effect pools past/future and weeks/years, rather than a separately reported future-only contrast. Final groups 16 young + 16 older = 32 analytic participants; recruitment 17 + 17 = 34, exclusions 1 + 1 = 2 for technical difficulties. N not derived from df. Target prints F(1, 30) = 14.49, eta-squared .326 (canonical rendering Z2), p_rep = .99. p_rep is not conventional p; no conversion made. Effect size, replication and success are unassigned placeholders.
